_help: TuKan Designs site configuration. Fill these in once the backend + PayPal are set up. Leave a value as an empty string to keep that feature in its safe fallback mode (custom orders and newsletter fall back to mailto; payments show a 'being set up' note; consultation shows call/email).
_orderHandlerUrl_note: Google Apps Script Web App URL (deployed as 'Anyone' access). Handles action:'customOrder', 'consultation', 'newsletter', and 'paymentLog'. See docs/apps-script/order-handler.gs and SETUP.md. Takes priority over formsubmitEmail when set.
_formsubmitEmail_note: Demo backend: form submissions are emailed to this address via formsubmit.co (no account needed). IMPORTANT: the very first submission triggers a one-time activation email to this inbox — click the link in it to start receiving submissions. Used only when orderHandlerUrl is empty. Swap to the Apps Script URL later for full control.
_paypal_note: paypalClientId = the Client ID from Brandon's PayPal business app (developer.paypal.com). paypalMode is 'live' or 'sandbox'. Leave clientId empty to keep manual payment fallback.
_contact_note: businessPhone in tel: format e.g. +12065551234. Update the tel: links in index.html to match once known.
